name: regular pieces follow their direction and mandatory captures
input: a red piece with one legal capture and another piece with a simple move
test:
forward = CheckersGame.empty()
forward.place(5, 2, Piece(Player.RED))
assert forward.move(5, 2, 4, 3)
assert forward.piece_at(4, 3) == Piece(Player.RED)

backward = CheckersGame.empty()
backward.place(5, 2, Piece(Player.RED))
assert not backward.move(5, 2, 6, 3)
assert backward.piece_at(5, 2) == Piece(Player.RED)

game = CheckersGame.empty()
game.place(5, 0, Piece(Player.RED))
game.place(5, 4, Piece(Player.RED))
game.place(4, 1, Piece(Player.BLACK))
assert not game.move(5, 4, 4, 5)
assert game.move(5, 0, 3, 2)
assert game.piece_at(4, 1) is None
assert game.piece_at(3, 2) == Piece(Player.RED)

name: a capture chain is locked to its landing piece and can end the game
input: red captures two black pieces on successive forward jumps
test:
game = CheckersGame.empty()
game.place(5, 0, Piece(Player.RED))
game.place(4, 1, Piece(Player.BLACK))
game.place(2, 3, Piece(Player.BLACK))
assert game.move(5, 0, 3, 2)
assert game.current_player == Player.RED
assert not game.move(3, 2, 2, 1)
assert game.move(3, 2, 1, 4)
assert game.piece_at(4, 1) is None
assert game.piece_at(2, 3) is None
assert game.piece_at(1, 4) == Piece(Player.RED)
assert game.is_game_over()
assert game.winner() == Player.RED

name: promotion crowns a piece and kings can move and capture backward
input: a red piece reaches row zero, then a crowned red piece makes backward moves
test:
promotion = CheckersGame.empty()
promotion.place(1, 2, Piece(Player.RED))
assert promotion.move(1, 2, 0, 3)
assert promotion.piece_at(0, 3) == Piece(Player.RED, king=True)
assert promotion.current_player == Player.BLACK

king_move = CheckersGame.empty()
king_move.place(3, 3, Piece(Player.RED, king=True))
assert king_move.move(3, 3, 4, 4)
assert king_move.piece_at(4, 4) == Piece(Player.RED, king=True)

king_capture = CheckersGame.empty()
king_capture.place(3, 3, Piece(Player.RED, king=True))
king_capture.place(4, 4, Piece(Player.BLACK))
assert king_capture.move(3, 3, 5, 5)
assert king_capture.piece_at(4, 4) is None
assert king_capture.piece_at(5, 5) == Piece(Player.RED, king=True)

name: invalid endpoints do not mutate board state
input: occupied destination, wrong owner, and out-of-bounds coordinates
test:
game = CheckersGame.empty()
game.place(5, 2, Piece(Player.RED))
game.place(4, 3, Piece(Player.BLACK))
assert not game.move(5, 2, 4, 3)
assert not game.move(4, 3, 3, 2)
assert not game.move(5, 2, -1, 0)
assert game.piece_at(5, 2) == Piece(Player.RED)
assert game.piece_at(4, 3) == Piece(Player.BLACK)
